insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Reshoevn8r UK delivered $1,643 in total sales for Week 46 on 78 units. The Refresh Kit was the standout at $248 (+66.7%) on 15 units (+66.7%), with its CVR up +62.5% to 9.4%, and the 16oz Cleaning Solution converted at a strong 23.4% (+9.2%). Friday, Nov 13 was the peak day at $380.

**Metrics to Watch —** The -21.6% WoW easing in total sales (prior week $2,096) was primarily driven by organic sales, which came in at $439 (-48.8% WoW), while PPC revenue held close to flat at $1,204 (-2.8%). The Essential Kit came in at $398 (-40.9%) as sessions fell -31.0% to 207, and the Waterproof Shoe Spray eased to $110 (-41.2%); the Shoe Cleaner Kit held at $306 (-10.1%) with sessions up +4.6% to 159. We are focused on rebuilding Essential Kit traffic to restore organic volume.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS improved to 1.41x from 1.33x as ad spend came in at $853 (prior $933) while PPC revenue held at $1,204. ACOS is 70.8% and TACoS rose to 51.9% (prior 44.53%) because organic sales were softer, so we are tightening bids on high-ACOS terms rather than adding spend; ad CVR is 9.98% on a 0.11% ad CTR.

**Actions This Week —** We will restore traffic to the Essential Kit (207 sessions) and Waterproof Shoe Spray with targeted Sponsored Products campaigns, and shift budget toward the Refresh Kit (9.4% CVR) and 16oz Cleaning Solution (23.4% CVR). We will also trim high-ACOS search terms to bring ACOS down from 70.8% and test new ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.11% heading into the holiday season.
